dict.Data facturii trebuie să fie de forma AA: The invoice date must be in the form YYYY-MM-DD.
dict.Data scadenței trebuie să fie de forma A: The due date must be in the form YYYY-MM-DD.
dict.Deocamdată se pot face doar facturi în l: For now, only invoices in lei (RON) can be made.
dict.Factura nu are niciun produs sau servici: The invoice has no product or service.
dict.Numărul facturii trebuie să conțină cel: The invoice number must contain at least one digit.
dict.Scadența nu poate fi înaintea datei fact: The due date cannot be before the invoice date.
dict.Factura ca PDF pentru client, cu aceleaș: The invoice as a PDF for the customer, with the same data as in the e-Factura file
dict.Fișierul e-Factura (XML UBL 2.1, CIUS-RO: The e-Factura file (XML UBL 2.1, CIUS-RO) for the invoice on this sheet, checked first; you upload it to SPV yourself (nothing is sent over the internet)
dict.Factură cu TVA pe cote, sumă în litere ș: Invoice with VAT by rate, amount in words and a number that increases by itself; it produces the e-Factura XML for SPV and the PDF for the customer.
dict.E o factură de stornare (notă de credit): This is a credit note: on the sheet it appears as a regular invoice.
dict.Factura are o sumă plătită în avans, car: The invoice has a prepaid amount, which does not appear on the sheet.
dict.Factura are reduceri sau taxe pe total,: The invoice has discounts or charges on the total, which do not appear on the sheet.
dict.Unele linii au reduceri: pe foaie apare: Some lines have discounts: the sheet shows the price after the discount.
dict.Deschide o factură e-Factura (XML sau ar: Opens an e-Factura invoice (XML or the ZIP archive from SPV) as an Invoice sheet, to correct or reuse
